description: User directed 2026-11-19: "add the elixir parity issues as tickets to the epic we gave to Elixir Parity". Owner: Elixir Parity. Found by Elixir Parity. The port's decoders() @type (otp_json.ex:865) is %{optional(:array_start) => array_start_fun(), ...}; decode_value() uses %{optional(binary()) => decode_value()}. fz's type parser rejects them: 'a map type key must be a literal atom or int'. Done: both parse and declare types on three paths; a self-oracle fixture covers them.
title: A map type key may be any type, as in Elixir
